title: The M2 decision rule on the 29 GEOID-Flood tiles of EMSR712-3: windows against the 0.72 gate
confidence_basis: Window counts of the team's own decision rule on a public benchmark sample. The rule accepted no window, so no layer exists to compare, and no label was read.
assumptions: The tiles are the Sentinel-1 GRD layer of the GEOID-Flood sample, linear sigma0, 1,024 by 1,024 cells of 10 m. Each tile is cut into windows of 256 cells at a stride of 128 cells: 49 windows a tile.
The decision rule is the frozen M2 kernel as the committed benchmark adapted it to sigma0. It was not changed.
run: The M2 decision rule on the 29 GEOID-Flood tiles of EMSR712-3: windows against the 0.72 gate
status_note: Receipt of one diagnosis run, made with protocol v1a and v1b in force. Every run is reported: a second run of this figure writes a new receipt that names this one.
computes: The frozen M2 decision rule on the 29 before-and-after tile pairs of the GEOID-Flood sample, with the counts and the between-class variance fractions of its windows. No label is read and no raster is written.
